text:
morgan (product): Quick sync: embeddings endpoint launch scope. Need final decisions on batching limits, dims we support, default model, and response format. Customers pushing different needs (search vs analytics).

jia (eng-ml): TL;dr: biggest diffs are support for variable dim outputs (512/1024/2048), per-item partial failures, and compact response option to save network.

sam (eng-platform): From infra POV batching cap matters most — we can't have unbounded batches. Propose hard request_size_limit=4096 vectors, but allow chunked upload for >4k. Also per-tenant concurrent requests limit.

elaine (product): Key customers: SearchCo wants 2048 for rerank; AcmeMedia ok with 512 but wants high throughput; FinBank needs PII handling/consent and stable vector dims. Launch criteria should include at least one anchor customer validated at each dimension.

oscar (sales): Can we offer an "opt-in 2048" beta? Would help close SearchCo. They'll pay for dedicated capacity.

jia (eng-ml): Model choices: rwd-embed-small (512), rwd-embed-medium (1024), open-llama-embed-2048 (2048). We should default to medium (1024) to balance cost/quality. Offer explicit model param.

morgan (product): Agree default=1024. But API must make switching explicit — avoid implicit dimension scaling.

sam (eng-platform): Response format debate: dense float arrays vs base64 gzipped floats vs int8 quantized + schema metadata. Dense arrays are simplest for customers but big egress. Compressed bytes save bandwidth and change SDK surface.

jia (eng-ml): Suggest two response modes: "dense" (float32 arrays) and "compact" (zlib base64 of float16 or int8 with quant metadata). Compact requires SDK helpers to decode.

elaine (product): Roadmap tradeoff: supporting compact at GA increases docs + SDK work. Maybe GA: dense only, GA+1: compact. But need explicit perf numbers to promise.

oscar (sales): If compact is post-GA, we need a migration promise for customers that need it fast. Could offer partnership pilot.

sam (eng-platform): Error model: for batch requests we should return per-item status + embeddings for success items. HTTP 207? Slack clients may not like 207. Alternative: 200 with per-item statuses in payload.

jia (eng-ml): Per-item statuses in 200 body is fine. Also include request-level metrics: processing_time_ms, model_used, dims. Example shape: 
```
{
  "data": [{"id":"1","status":200,"embedding":[...]}],
  "model":"rwd-embed-medium",
  "processing_time_ms":123
}
```

morgan (product): Good. Also need to decide input batching format: array of strings vs newline-delimited text stream + optional ids. Keep array-of-objects for clarity: {id, text, metadata}.

sam (eng-platform): Rate limits: tokenization doesn't apply but must guard large objects. cap item_size_chars=20000. Also rate-limit by vectors/sec per-tenant. We should add headers: X-RateLimit-... and usage hints in response.

elaine (product): Launch criteria checklist (proposed):
- Perf: 95th latency for 1-16 items under 200ms for default dims on hosted tier
- Throughput: validate batching gives 3-5x cost improvement vs single-item calls
- SDKs: generate helpers to decode dense arrays and (post-GA) compact format
- Docs: migration guide, quota docs, example clients
- Security: PII handling guidance + opt-in disable retention for regulated customers
- Customers: 2 anchor customers per dimension (512/1024/2048) or documented pilot exceptions

oscar (sales): Fine but be pragmatic on anchor customers; SearchCo will do 2048 pilot if we can promise dedicated capacity.

jia (eng-ml): Implementation notes: kernel selection picks float16 path for 1024/2048 to save memory. Will expose model_profile perf numbers. Also KV prefix caching for repeated prefixes.

morgan (product): Action items: 
- @jia: run perf matrix (dims x batch_sizes [1,8,64,512]) and publish numbers by EOD Tue (1790003456).
- @sam: finalize request_size_limit and headers, propose draft API response schema by Wed.
- @elaine: coordinate pilot customers and finalize launch checklist by Fri.

oscar (sales): I'll line up SearchCo pilot and confirm their capacity budget.

infra-bot: Reminder: schedule a canary deploy window once platform changes land.

morgan (product): One more UI/Console ask: expose model_used + dims and cost_estimate per call in Console logs. Helps SRE and billing.

sam (eng-platform): doable — will add telemetry events.

morgan (product): OK let's reconvene after perf runs. If numbers look good, GA timeline is 6 weeks.

jira: create ticket EMB-325 "Embeddings GA: API schema + batching limits" assigned to eng-ml + eng-platform

jia (eng-ml): tiny note: support for variable-length embeddings in a single response (mixed dims) should be disallowed — enforce uniform dims per request. Saves a ton of complexity.

morgan (product): Agreed. Uniform dims per request only.

sam (eng-platform): final: request/response example for docs (draft):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model":"rwd-embed-medium",
  "input":[{"id":"a","text":"how to bake"},{"id":"b","text":"bake bread"}],
  "response_format":"dense"
}

200 OK
{
  "data":[{"id":"a","status":200,"embedding":[0.001, -0.23, ...]}],
  "model":"rwd-embed-medium",
  "dims":1024
}
```

morgan (product): Perfect. Closing thread for now — will follow up when perf numbers posted. :rocket:
jira: create ticket EMB-325 "Embeddings GA: API schema + batching limits" assigned to eng-ml + eng-platform
